sanskrit: yāsām ārād āghoṣāmo vātasyeva pṛthag yataḥ | tāsāṃ śvanvatīnām indro api kṛtac chiraḥ ||
english: Of those whose howling from afar we hear, moving separately like the wind — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yāḥ purastād ācaranti sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ (…) ||
english: Those who roam in front together with the rays of the sun — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yā vātam anusaṃyanty antarikṣe adho divaḥ (…) ||
english: Those who follow the wind through the mid-air below the sky — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yāsāṃ preṅkho divi baddho antarikṣe hiraṇyayaḥ (…) ||
english: Those whose golden swing is fastened in heaven, in the mid-air — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yās talpān anunṛtyanty antarikṣe hiraṇyayān (…) ||
english: Those who dance along the golden couches in the mid-air — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yāḥ patanti vātarathā uttānāḥ pādaghātinīḥ (…) ||
english: Those who fly on wind-chariots, supine, striking with their feet — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yā vṛkṣaṃ parisarpanti sācy akṣī karikratīḥ (…) ||
english: Those who creep about a tree, with sidelong eyes, chattering and clamorous — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yāś catvare saṃgacchante vikumbāś celavāsinīḥ (…) ||
english: Those who assemble at the crossroads, disheveled, dwelling amid rags — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yāsāṃ sikatavāpiṣu gṛho mito hiraṇyayaḥ (…) ||
english: Those whose golden home is secretly hidden in sandbank pools — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yā ārokaiḥ prapadyante puṣkarair iva jāmayaḥ (…) ||
english: Those who mount upon elevated places like kinswomen with lotus-flowers — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yā nadīḥ pratigāhante saṃrabhya kanyā iva (…) ||
english: Those who plunge headlong into rivers, clinging together like maidens — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yās tīrthāni vigāhante 'ghnyāḥ śvasatīr iva (…) ||
english: Those who wade into fords, hissing like inviolable cows — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yāḥ samudrād uccaranty uccair ghoṣān karikratīḥ (…) ||
english: Those who rise up out of the ocean, uttering loud cries, chattering and clamorous — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: yā gacchanti janaṃjanam icchantīḥ prayutaṃ bahu | tāsāṃ śvanvatīnām indro api kṛtac chiraḥ ||
english: Those who go from person to person desiring many by the myriad — of those dog-companied ones, Indra has cut off the head.

sanskrit: agnir āyuṣmān sa vanaspatibhir āyuṣmān | sa māyuṣmān āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Agni is long-lived; long-lived is he together with the forest-trees. May he make me long-lived and make this one long-lived.

sanskrit: vāyur āyuṣmān so 'ntarikṣeṇāyuṣmān (…) ||
english: Vāyu is long-lived; long-lived is he together with the mid-air. May he make me long-lived and make this one long-lived.

sanskrit: sūrya āyuṣmān sa divāyuṣmān (…) ||
english: Sūrya is long-lived; long-lived is he together with the sky. May he make me long-lived and make this one long-lived.

sanskrit: candra āyuṣmān sa nakṣatrair āyuṣmān (…) ||
english: Candra is long-lived; long-lived is he together with the asterisms. May he make me long-lived and make this one long-lived.

sanskrit: soma āyuṣmān sa oṣadhībhir āyuṣmān (…) ||
english: Soma is long-lived; long-lived is he together with the plants. May he make me long-lived and make this one long-lived.

sanskrit: yajña āyuṣmān sa dakṣiṇābhir āyuṣmān (…) ||
english: The sacrifice is long-lived; long-lived is it together with the sacrificial fees. May it make me long-lived and make this one long-lived.

sanskrit: samudra āyuṣmān sa nadībhir āyuṣmān | sa māyuṣmān āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: The ocean is long-lived; long-lived is it together with the rivers. May it make me long-lived and make this one long-lived.

sanskrit: brahmāyuṣmat tad brahmacāribhir āyuṣmat | tan māyuṣmad āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Brahman is replete with long life; long-lived is it together with brahma-students. May it make me replete with long life and make this one long-lived.

sanskrit: indra āyuṣmān sa vīryeṇāyuṣmān | sa māyuṣmān āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Indra is long-lived; long-lived is he together with heroic power. May he make me long-lived and make this one long-lived.

sanskrit: devā āyuṣmantas te 'mṛtenāyuṣmantaḥ | te māyuṣmanta āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇvantu ||
english: The gods are long-lived; long-lived are they together with immortality. May they make me long-lived and make this one long-lived.

sanskrit: prajāpatir āyuṣmān sa prajābhir āyuṣmān | sa māyuṣmān āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Prajāpati is long-lived; long-lived is he together with progeny. May he make me long-lived and make this one long-lived.

sanskrit: dakṣiṇā mā dakṣiṇato dakṣiṇā pātu savyataḥ | paścād anuvyādhāt pātu sarvasyā bhavahetyāḥ ||
english: May the sacrificial gift (dakṣiṇā) protect me from the right; may the dakṣiṇā protect me from the left. May it protect me from behind, from whatever shaft the world may discharge.

sanskrit: paśunā tvaṃ paśupate dvipād dattvā catuṣpadā | ātmanvatīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ prāṇaṃ dattvā prāṇihi ||
english: O Paśupati, lord of cattle, having given two-footed and four-footed animals, giving the dakṣiṇā that possesses the very self, giving life-breath — breathe on!

sanskrit: yāṃ dadāsi śraddadhāno dakṣiṇāṃ brāhmaṇakṛte | sā tvā yakṣmāt pārayatv agneḥ saṃtāpād divyasya śokāt ||
english: The dakṣiṇā that you, with faith, give on behalf of a brahmin — may that carry you across from disease (yakṣman), from the scorching heat of fire, from the grief of divine affliction.

sanskrit: dadāsīmāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ mā ta āmamac chalyān yakṣmān vi vṛhāmo vayaṃ te | karṇaśūlam upahatyā arātīḥ sarve yakṣmā apa tiṣṭhantu sākam ||
english: You give this dakṣiṇā; may it not be raw for you. We pluck out for you the sharp diseases, the yakṣman. Knocking down the ear-ache and all hostilities, may all diseases withdraw together.

sanskrit: annena prāṇaṃ vanute tiro dhatte paridhānena yakṣmam | hiraṇyam aśvaṃ gāṃ dadat kṛṇute varma dakṣiṇām ||
english: With food one wins life-breath; with clothing one wards off disease (yakṣman). One who gives gold, a horse, a cow makes of the dakṣiṇā an armor.

sanskrit: uṣṇīṣaṃ tvā śīrṣaktyā vāsas tvā tanvāmayāt | candraṃ hiraṇyam andhyāt karṇād dattaṃ śukraṃ bhrājad bādhiryāt pātu dakṣiṇā ||
english: A turban given as dakṣiṇā — may it protect you from head-ailment; a garment — from bodily disease; a shining bright gold ornament given as dakṣiṇā — from blindness of the eye, from affliction of the ear, from deafness.

sanskrit: upabarhaṇaṃ tvā grīvāmayān maṇayo yakṣmād datkravyāt | aṅgarogād abhyañjanam annaṃ tvāntaṣṭyāmayāt ||
english: A pillow given as dakṣiṇā — may it protect you from neck-ailments; beads from the flesh-eating yakṣman; an ointment from disease of the limbs; food from internal intestinal disease.

sanskrit: adhaspadād āmayataḥ pado rogād upānahau | daṇḍas tvā dattaḥ pari pātu sarpād dakṣiṇataḥ prayato dakṣiṇena ||
english: Sandals given as dakṣiṇā — may they protect the ailing foot from disease of the foot from below the sole. A staff given as dakṣiṇā — may it protect you on all sides from the serpent, as you go forth to the south, on the right.

sanskrit: saumanasaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dakṣamāṇā iṣam ūrjaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ saṃvasānāḥ | bhagasya dhārām avase pratīmaḥ ||
english: Presenting the dakṣiṇā with good-will, receiving together the dakṣiṇā as food and strength, we turn to the stream of Bhaga for our protection.

sanskrit: sahasrāṅgā śataṃ jyotīṃṣy asyā yajñasya paprir amṛtā svargā | ā na etu dakṣiṇā viśvarūpā- -ahiṃsantīṃ prati gṛhṇīma enām ||
english: Of a thousand limbs, a hundred are the lights of this sacrifice; the dakṣiṇā is its fulfiller, immortal, celestial. May the all-formed dakṣiṇā come to us; we receive her as one who brings no harm.
